label: Amazon Product Scraper
description: Amazon Product Scraper (3 credits per successful call)

fields.name: query
fields.label: Query
fields.description: Search keyword. Builds the marketplace search URL (see location_name / se_domain) when url is omitted. Required first call unless url given. Aliases: queries, keyword, q.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Url
fields.description: Amazon search/category URL or product /dp/ URL. Takes precedence over query. Product URLs return a single result with next_cursor=null; search URLs paginate. Aliases: urls.

fields.name: cursor
fields.label: Cursor
fields.description: Pagination cursor returned in the previous response's `next_cursor`. Pass it back unchanged to fetch the next page. When `next_cursor` is null, you have reached the last page.

fields.name: location_name
fields.label: Location Name
fields.description: Marketplace + delivery location. Sets the Amazon domain, currency and delivery ZIP (prices/delivery dates as a shopper there sees them). Aliases: location, location_code (e.g. 2840), country (ISO2).

fields.name: language_name
fields.label: Language Name
fields.description: Storefront language, as a name ("English (United States)") or code (en_US). Default: the marketplace language. Aliases: language, language_code.

fields.name: se_domain
fields.label: Se Domain
fields.description: Amazon domain override (amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de, …). Default: chosen from location_name.

fields.name: zip_code
fields.label: Zip Code
fields.description: Delivery postal code override (default: the marketplace capital, e.g. 10001 for the US). Aliases: postal_code, zip.

fields.name: set_delivery_location
fields.label: Set Delivery Location
fields.description: Pin the session delivery location to zip_code before scraping (2 extra requests per session). false = whatever location Amazon infers from the proxy IP (off-country IPs may get no prices).

fields.name: price_min
fields.label: Price Min
fields.description: Minimum product price (marketplace currency).

fields.name: price_max
fields.label: Price Max
fields.description: Maximum product price (marketplace currency).

fields.name: sort_by
fields.label: Sort By
fields.description: Result sorting. Default: Amazon's "Featured" order.

fields.name: department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: Amazon department, e.g. "Electronics", "Books", "Home & Kitchen" (or a raw search alias like "electronics").

fields.name: search_param
fields.label: Search Param
fields.description: Extra Amazon search URL params, e.g. "&rh=p_72:1248882011". Ignored when price_min, price_max or sort_by is set.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Tag
fields.description: Your own identifier (max 255 chars), echoed on every result.

fields.name: depth
fields.label: Depth
fields.description: Max products across all pages, organic + sponsored (max 700). Pagination stops once reached. Locked in cursor. Alias: max_items.

fields.name: max_crawl_pages
fields.label: Max Crawl Pages
fields.description: Max search-result pages to walk; next_cursor is null after this page. Locked in cursor. Alias: max_pages.

fields.name: use_proxy
fields.label: Use Proxy
fields.description: Use Scrapier's residential proxy pool when true (default: true)
